description: This file defines the UserService class, which provides methods to read user data from a repository, including fetching a single user by identification number and fetching a paginated list of users.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class that manages user data retrieval, converting UserEntity objects to User DTOs and handling entity not found exceptions.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a User DTO by the user's identification number, throwing an exception if the user is not found.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of User DTOs.
